_comment: Data-driven panel list for the TTTR Tools toolbox. Each entry names a tool by its GUI entrypoint (module:Class); the toolbox lazily imports and instantiates it. Set "embed": true for QMainWindow tools that must be flattened into a plain panel. Add a tool by adding an entry here — no Python needed. Use {"separator": true} to group.
title: 🧰 TTTR Tools

panels.name: ALEX Creator
panels.description: Convert ALEX macro-time modulation into micro-time so ALEX data runs through PIE pipelines.

panels.name: Micro-time Shifter
panels.description: Apply global and per-channel micro-time shifts to TTTR files.

panels.name: PTU Header Editor
panels.description: View, edit, add and remove header tags in PicoQuant PTU files.

panels.name: Split / Convert
panels.description: Split large TTTR files into segments and convert between container formats.

panels.name: Count Rate Analysis
panels.description: Count rates per detector channel across many TTTR files, with mean/std and a per-file plot.
